sections.description: The ST Notary Free WordPress Theme is a modern, professional, and fully responsive theme created for notary publics, mobile notary signing agents, apostille services, legal consultants, attorneys, law firms, paralegals, title and escrow agencies, and document authentication businesses. Whether you run a mobile notary service, remote online notarization (RON) business, legal document preparation firm, translation and certification service, tax and accounting office, insurance agency, or immigration consultancy, this theme provides the perfect foundation for building a clean, user-friendly, and professional website. Designed to enhance credibility and client engagement, it includes dedicated sections for About, Services, and Trust Bar, allowing you to showcase your expertise, certifications, testimonials, and service areas to establish trust with potential clients. The theme is conversion-focused, featuring strategically placed Call-to-Action (CTA) buttons, appointment and booking friendly layouts, and contact-ready pages that help generate leads and support business growth. Lightweight, fast loading, and SEO-friendly, the ST Notary Free Theme delivers excellent Core Web Vitals performance and a seamless browsing experience across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. Built with clean, accessible, cross-browser compatible code, it works with the block editor (Gutenberg), supports WooCommerce, and is compatible with popular WordPress plugins such as Elementor, Contact Form 7, and Yoast SEO. Translation ready and RTL friendly, it offers flexible customization options for colors, logo, header, menus, and typography through the WordPress Customizer, enabling you to personalize your business, corporate, agency, consulting, or professional services website without any coding knowledge. For a professional, affordable, and conversion-oriented online presence, download the ST Notary Free Theme today and create a website that helps your business stand out. Theme Demo Page: https://striviothemes.com/demo/st-notary-pro/
